title: Merge
subtitle: Two arrivals unlock the gate.

+.name: merge
+.description: Requires two echoes arriving on the same tick.

router.note: Point the top and bottom echoes at the merge node.

hints: The merge rewrite is: A + A -> B. Both echoes must land on the same tick.
The distances are symmetric on purpose. Don't overthink it.
One router redirects the top echo. One redirects the bottom.
intro: Two sources, one merge, one goal. Route both echoes to arrive at the same tick.
outro: Merges are the first place timing starts to matter. Later chambers weaponize this.
